'''2000 Quebec Provincial Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG provincial championship held in Quebec, Canada in spring 2000. [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted his Light deck as the "Qc Championship winner deck".<ref name="dt-4883">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4883 Qc  Championship winner deck], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 30 March 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/4883/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/4883/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2000 (before 30 March)
* '''Site:''' Quebec, Canada
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Yannick Lapointe]]
* '''Players:''' 48<ref name="tr-d397" />
